deprecated_device_tracker_yaml.description:
The Xiaomi device tracker at `{host}` was configured via YAML. It has been imported as a Xiaomi integration entry in the UI.

To complete the migration, remove only the Xiaomi device tracker block from your `configuration.yaml` file (leave any Xiaomi `camera:` entries in place) and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
device_tracker:
  - platform: xiaomi
```
deprecated_device_tracker_yaml.title: Xiaomi device tracker YAML configuration is deprecated

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
The YAML configuration for Xiaomi at `{host}` could not be imported because the connection failed.

Please check that `{host}` is reachable, update your `configuration.yaml` if needed, and restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: YAML configuration import failed: cannot connect

yaml_import_invalid_auth.description:
The YAML configuration for Xiaomi at `{host}` could not be imported because the credentials are invalid.

Please update your `configuration.yaml` with valid credentials and restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_invalid_auth.title: YAML configuration import failed: invalid authentication
